text:
olivia: Heads up y'all 4e2 Were launching the Community Contribution Sprint and releasing the community-kits v1.0.0 today. This is a coordinated push to improve onboarding, add small starter projects, and seed 10 newcomer-friendly issues. More below and links included.

raj: Congrats! Whats in v1.0.0 vs the beta?

olivia: v1.0.0 is focused on stability and docs: simplified local dev scripts, three starter apps (chat, reranker, embeddings), a local eval harness, and a new onboarding.md. Also added CODE_OF_CONDUCT and maintainers guidance. Release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-kits/releases/tag/v1.0.0

nina: Will org maintainers be listed in the package? We should surface who to ping for each kit.

olivia: Yes  we added a MAINTAINERS.md and contact pointers. Were asking maintainers to set office hours during the Sprint week.

release-bot: Released: community-kits v1.0.0 by @olivia 4c4 assets: tarball, changelog, signing key. https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-kits/releases/tag/v1.0.0

raj: Nice. How do folks sign up for office hours / mentoring?

olivia: Signup form: https://forms.gle/redsprint-signup  choose "mentor" or "new contributor" and preferred time blocks.

nina: Are there any prizes or incentives?

olivia: Were running a small recognition program  contributor badges, a highlight in the community newsletter, and 5 $250 microgrants for consecutive quality PRs. See the release notes.

community-bot: Reminder: Please check Contributor License Agreement (CLA) requirements before merging. Link: https://cla.redwood.inference/docs

alex: Quick ask  can we add a label "sprint-good-first" and a tiny template that explains how to run the project locally? Newbies often get stuck on env setup.

olivia: Good call. I added labels: sprint-good-first, sprint-help-wanted. Also updated onboarding.md with exact env commands and a troubleshooting FAQ.

raj: Will there be a kickoff call? Timezones are rough.

olivia: Kickoff will be two sessions: 10am PT and 6pm CET on Monday of Sprint week. Both will be recorded. Link and calendar invites coming soon.

nina: Can internal teams nominate community maintainers for microgrants?

olivia: Yes, nominate via the form. Well evaluate on impact & likelihood to ship within 30 days.

release-bot: Note: security advisory included  small dependency pin to avoid a CI flake. Patch is in the release.

olivia: Thank you all. Please amplify the release on socials and in any user groups. If youre mentoring, drop your availability in the signup form and DM me so I can add you to the schedule. :seedling:
